edits.anchor: Approximators (约) are a node with the number as :op1
edits.text: Approximators (约) are a source-language concept node 约 (never English 'about', never dropped, never a bare :mod) with the number as :op1, placed under :quant

temporal 后 is never translated to 'after'; 此后 is 后 with :op1 此. A 后/尔后 linking clauses is a `consecutive` coordination, not a concept head over the earlier clause, and sentence adverbs 尔后/首先 are :temporal on the event

streets are `road`, malls/buildings `building`, hospitals `facility`; X籍 nationality modifiers are `nationality` with :name (not `country`), and 国籍 with listed nationalities is ARG2-of include-91; a named event or war is concept `event`/`war` with :name of all tokens, not a predicate built from its last token
- Members of a group, convoy or organization (workers of a convoy, staff of an organization) are linked by :part-of to the group, not :possessor/:possessor-of.

- 致使 is the abstract `have-cause-91` (ARG1 the effect event, ARG2 the cause event, no aspect, modal or temporal of its own); the participants (e.g. the dead) are arguments of the effect event, not of have-cause-91.
- A clause introduced by 当时 is a :temporal modifier of the main event (shared subject by re-entrancy), not a coordinated clause, and 当时 is not a concept.
- Coordinates (北纬/东经 values) are a geographical-coordinate-entity with numeric :lat and :long, no unit nodes, under :place of the event.
- A temporal-quantity such as 'N days before X' is a document-level node: DCT :before it, and it :contained the event it locates; X is not related directly to the located event.

suggestions: The skill has contradictory conventions (e.g. but-91 vs contrast-91 for 但, chaining Gaza to first vs previous mention, 其中 include-91 vs plain coordination); review the gold guidelines to settle each.
Provide the annotator a checklist pass at the end verifying every event node has aspect, modal and temporal relations and every abstract relation node has none.
